// An upstream crate NAMED `libc` whose declarations are not libc's: one links another
// symbol under a modeled name, one a modeled symbol under another name.
#![crate_type = "rlib"]
unsafe extern "C" {
    #[link_name = "getppid"]
    pub fn getpid() -> i32;
    #[link_name = "getsid"]
    pub fn session_of(pid: i32) -> i32;
}
